name: colonies-05-mother-machine
title: Mother machine (viva-munk) — device run + phenotype distributions
description:
Run the canonical viva-munk MOTHER MACHINE — narrow dead-end channels with a
flow channel that washes out cells crossing the top — populated by viva-munk's
simple grow/divide agents. The simulation runs now and produces (a) an
animated GIF of the device running and (b) distribution figures for the core
single-cell phenotypes: size at division, time between birth and division, and
added size before division (the adder plot).

Simulations run now; biological conclusions are HELD for experimental
mother-machine data (a planned comparison study, colonies-09). This study
establishes the measurement + visualization pipeline against cheap agents.

baseline.name: mother-machine-simple
baseline.note:
Nominal composite for the workbench catalog. The actual run drives the
viva-munk mother_machine_document (via v2ecoli.colony_bench.devices) with
simple grow/divide agents — the canonical device geometry, not the free
colony. Phenotypes are extracted uniformly by colony_bench.phenotypes.

pipeline_gate.proceed_condition:
Requires the shared cell-tier factory, geometry builders, and phenotype
extractor stood up in colonies-04.
